description:
You are a group fitness instructor preparing to host a premium virtual yoga session on Jitsi Meet. Only paying clients should be able to access this class, so you need to set a room password.

You are already in the Jitsi Meet room 'premium-yoga-class' in Firefox.

Your task:
1. Open the Security Options panel. You can find this by clicking the shield/lock icon in the bottom meeting toolbar. If you don't see it directly, click the '...' (three dots / More Actions) overflow menu button in the toolbar and select 'Security options'.
2. In the Security Options panel that appears, find the password section and the input field labeled 'Add a password' or similar.
3. Type the exact password: FlowState24
4. Press Enter or click the submit/add button to apply the password.
5. Leave the Security Options panel open after setting the password.

After completing this task, the room should be password-protected with the password 'FlowState24'. A lock icon should appear in the toolbar indicating the room is secured.
